prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1444; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents right-side damage consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change: the rear quarter panel has a long scrape with a crease running into the door skin, the side mirror housing is cracked, and the rear bumper cover has a scuffed corner. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as reported. Paint transfer and the direction of the body deformation support the same contact point. The repair plan calls for replacing the mirror housing, straightening and refinishing the quarter panel, and blending adjacent paint. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the work shown. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the parts and labor charges submitted contain no repeated entries.
